works.body:
Hello @. Thank you for your wonderful illustrations. I really like your illustrations and love the use of color, composition, and all of your patterns. When I see you uploading your pictures, it makes me happy. Thank you very much.
I am sending you a request to draw my original character this time.

──────────────────

Brother
Name: Seiichiro Mimatani
Age: 18, 177cm
Personality: Quiet and calm, not the type to talk much
Hobbies: Reading books
Fighting Style: Mainly uses knives, not good with guns psychologically

The eldest son born into a family of hit men. Although he is skilled, he does not like killing or hurting people very much. Therefore, he does not like his parents, who are trained to follow in his footsteps. He cares about his younger sister.

［Past History.]
He decided to become a hitman after his family was killed when he was a child. His goal is to find out who killed his family and kill them. He only does the minimum amount of killing necessary, even when he is asked to do so.

Sister
Name: Kazuki Mimatani
15 years old, 157cm
Personality: cheerful, friendly, and cruel by any means necessary to achieve her goals.
Hobby: Collecting knives
Fighting Style: Mainly uses two guns, sometimes knives

He was raised in a family of hit men, but was adopted by a yakuza (gangster) family. His goal is to meet his own brother, and he plans to become the head of his adopted family in order to gather information. Since his brother was unwilling to kill, his sister, who is willing to kill, promised to take his place. She likes her brother's knife-handling skills.

［A Synopsis of the Past.]
His sister was attacked when she was young, her parents were killed, and she was kidnapped. Since she was so young, she was taken and raised in the same house where she was kidnapped for the purpose of using her as a human resource. She uses everything to meet her brother.

［Their relationship.]
They care for each other.

[Ref.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15QBoEIeIGdjuDqg2_iZ_71tw9ny2Aa86


─────────────────

If you don't mind, I would appreciate it if you could draw the composition as if the two of them are killing or fighting each other. Thank you very much.

こんにちは、先生の作品がとても好きです。私と友達のオリジナルキャラクターのイラストを頼みたいのですが、よろしいでしょうか。

ピンクの髪は、女装してる男子高校生です。

白髪は、JKの格好をしてる社会人です。

二人は、普段一緒に超自然現象を調査して、その中で報酬を受けてお金を稼いでいます。

構図、ポーズ等について先生の好きなように、お任せします。

また、もし練習絵や習作などがあれば、保留してもらえないでしょうか。なくても大丈夫です。

イラストの完成を心より楽しみにしています。何卒よろしくお願いいたします。

Nice to meet you, sensei's works are super amazing! Could you please draw my OCs?
Please draw them in 2020s paro, and feel free to change their clothings. Please let ネイサン wear glasses, and you don't have to make ソレル's sideburns become white(which means all the hair is brown/ deep burgundy are fine!). 
As long as they interact with each other, no matter at work or dating in leisure time, please feel free to choose the detailed scene!

Nice to meet you! My name is hiyoko.
If you don't mind, I would like to request the following two people!
They will be explorers from a CoC secret scenario, but there are no spoilers in the links!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1saZ1o1zjnUfPUyQAu3Bfj3Q-mJfLEc-j?usp=sharing

About the above characters
Both are in their mid-twenties.
HO1 has only roommate feelings for HO2, and HO2 has almost obsessive feelings for HO1. However, they both have quiet personalities, so I think it is difficult to show their attitudes.
I'll leave it all up to you to decide on the composition.

Other matters
The illustration may be used as a social networking icon.

We apologize for the length of this message.
Please take care of yourself as the weather is getting colder.

Hi, nice to meet you @.

I love @'s illustrations. I really like the way you draw, and both boys and girls are cute and cool. I was so happy and surprised when I saw @'s picture of a certain Holy Grail War for the first time. The use of color is also wonderful and I always look at your drawings with a sense of gratitude. Thank you very much.

I am very sorry for your busy schedule, but I would like to send you a request to draw our OC if you would like.
What I would like you to draw is two OCs, myself and a friend.
These two are colleagues who work for the city hall.

Senior, male
26 years old
He is 178cm tall.
He is basically a clumsy character who does not assert himself very much.
He wants to help all those who are in trouble in front of him and wants them to depend on him.
He is actually quite concerned about his juniors.
Keywords: fire, flame, two-faced, altruistic, first love

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/11BVSArH7rHXn8y11U5R9XiwxTUxseL9C?usp=sharing

Junior, female
Age: 23
She is 23 years old and 165cm tall.
She does not show much emotion in her facial expression and attitude, and cannot express her feelings well.
She actually worships her seniors.
Keywords: flower hairpin, inorganic, strong

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uuX4MwUZUiCfHH39mNLU7xa-p8QBKPaW?usp=sharing

They both fight. The senior (male) is two-fisted and the junior (female) is kicking.

Their relationship: they care for each other, but both are too clumsy to communicate to the other at all. The feelings they hold for each other are not romantic love.

There are no specifications for poses or situations, so I would be very happy if you could draw them as you wish.
I would appreciate your consideration.
Thank you very much.

Heise / 187cm

Relationships

Outline
You can design and dress her in any outfit you like!

You can use "stories, art galleries, movie theaters, azure skies, waterfront suicides" as motifs.
You can use any of these motifs.

If the amount is not enough, please appeal for an appropriate amount.
You can draw whatever you like! Your drawings are truly beautiful!
